seo_title: Green Valley Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Green Valley, Arizona for 2026: 4 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Green Valley celebrates Christmas with holiday shows and a family movie at Green Valley Recreation, library programs for little ones and, a short drive south, the Rio Rico tree lighting and Tubac's luminarias.
celebrates: Green Valley Recreation fills December with holiday shows in the West Center Auditorium at 1070 S. Calle de las Casitas, from A Reba Christmas to A Very Vintage Christmas, A Joyful Holiday Evening and the Civic Orchestra of Tucson's Holiday Fantasia. For families, it also shows The Santa Clause as a $2 matinee for members and guests. The Joyner-Green Valley Library on North La Canada Drive lists Family Storytime, 5 and Under Free Play and Music Monday in December. Farther south, Rio Rico lights its community tree with Santa and the Grinch, and Tubac glows with luminarias in its Historic Village.
lastyear: In 2025, Rio Rico Rotary held its third annual Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony on Saturday, November 29, from 2 to 8 pm at Garrett's Plaza, according to an Instagram post promoting the event. Tubac's Luminaria Nights ran on Friday and Saturday, December 5 and 6, from 5 to 9 pm, and Visit Tubac's announcement promised thousands of lights, festive shopping and a petting zoo for kids. Both events return in 2026 on new dates.
facts: Rio Rico Rotary's tree lighting is its fourth annual in 2026, so the tradition began in 2023. Luminaria Nights always takes place on the first Friday and Saturday in December, lighting up the Historic Village in Tubac with luminarias. The Civic Orchestra of Tucson describes its holiday concert as a symphonic celebration with an artist conversation before the show. The Joyner-Green Valley Library closes on Thanksgiving Day, the Friday after Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.
trains: Green Valley has no train service of its own. The nearest Amtrak station is in Tucson, served by the Sunset Limited and the Texas Eagle, according to Amtrak. In Tucson, the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum sits in the old Southern Pacific depot and shows steam locomotive 1673, and Old Pueblo Trolley in South Tucson keeps historic streetcars. For a holiday train ride, the Verde Canyon Railroad runs its Magical Christmas Journey in Clarkdale, far to the north.

faq: Where can kids meet Santa near Green Valley?

Santa Claus and the Grinch are listed at the Rio Rico Rotary Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony, and Santa and Mrs. Claus meet children at the Tubac Center of the Arts during Luminaria Nights. Each event listing on this page gives the date, time and details.
Does Green Valley Recreation have family Christmas events?

Yes. Green Valley Recreation runs holiday concerts in the West Center Auditorium and a Santa Clause movie matinee for members and their guests. Concert prices differ for members and the general public, so check each listing before you buy tickets.
Does the Joyner-Green Valley Library have kids programs in December?

The library at 601 N. La Canada Drive lists Family Storytime, 5 and Under Free Play and Music Monday in December. The library page does not state whether programs are free, and the library is closed on Thanksgiving Day, the day after and Christmas Day.
What is Luminaria Nights in Tubac?

Luminaria Nights lights up Tubac's Historic Village with luminarias on the first Friday and Saturday in December. Visitors can shop late, hear live music, enjoy treats and meet Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Tubac Center of the Arts.
Is there a Christmas train ride near Green Valley?

The closest holiday train ride on our Arizona list is the Verde Canyon Railroad's Magical Christmas Journey in Clarkdale. Closer to home, the Southern Arizona Transportation Museum and Old Pueblo Trolley in Tucson show historic trains and streetcars.
